title: The plugin offers its own bar, and measures value not only cost
description: The operator's answer to Part 6's fifth question, and P4/P5/P8: the checks this repo runs on itself are offered as optional gate entries; a number in the panel is about what the gate caught rather than what it spent; and the control surface the model rests on can say whether anyone opened it.
desiredOutcome: The bar is available as opt-in gate entries that change nothing for a plan that does not ask for them, and their instruction carries the refusal path a host classifier can trigger; one derived row says what a red gate caught before a commit; and the doctor can say whether the panel was ever opened, saying never rather than staying silent.
